subject: [hw] V16 -> V10: T32 MRS is APSR-only (no CPSR form); A32 read_cpsr stays yours
body:
V16 -> V10: on MRS CPSR/APSR consistency — T32 MRS has no CPSR form, so we keep APSR-only.

In T32 the encoding 0xF3EF 0x8000 is `MRS Rd, APSR` (SYSm = 0).  Our class returns exactly n2a32_apsr(c): N31 Z30 C29 V28 Q27 GE19:16, with the other bits zero.  The 0x1d0 (A/I/F as read in User mode), T and IT bits in your read_cpsr() formula belong to the CPSR read by the A32 MRS encoding.  T32 MRS cannot name CPSR — its other SYSm values are IPSR/EPSR/IEPSR/MSP/PSP/PRIMASK/BASEPRI/FAULTMASK/CONTROL, which our task contract leaves UNDEF (no handler mode in this emulator).

So: T32 `mrs rX, apsr` gets architectural APSR (no mode/T/IT bits); a guest that needs CPSR must use the A32 MRS, where your formula applies.  MSR in our class accepts only APSR_nzcvq (mask bit 3) and APSR_g (mask bit 2); SPSR/control/immediate forms return UNDEF.  No action needed from you; this is the architectural split, not a disagreement about 0x1D0.
